applicableClauses.note: An oven that no longer heats during normal use is a manufacturing defect covered by this clause; Borealis appliances are covered products.
24-month warranty period in all regions. warranty_lookup reports the claim date within standard coverage.
The battery period does not apply; the oven has no battery and the failure is a heating fault.
No liquid contact reported or visible.
No repair or opening by an unauthorized party is reported.

structuredOutput.summary: Covered: an oven that stops heating during normal use is a manufacturing defect under POL-5, and the claim is within the 24-month warranty period of POL-1 as computed by warranty_lookup. The liquid-damage and unauthorized-repair exclusions (POL-3, POL-4) do not apply.
